int r, c;
long long total;

void explore(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
    long long diff = abs(x - y);
    if (best <= 1 || diff - C[v1][r] * C[v2][r] >= best) {
        return;
    }
    if (v1 == r - 1 && v2 == r - 1) {
        long long diff2 = abs(x - y);
        if (diff2 < best) {
            best = diff2;
            best_z = x;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (v1 >= r) {
        long long delta1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r];
        long long sum2 = C[v2][r];
        explore(x, y + delta1 * sum2, v1 - 1, v2);
    }
    if (v2 >= r) {
        long long sum1 = C[v1][r];
        long long delta2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
        explore(x + sum1 * delta2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
    }

        long long sum1 = C[v1][r];
        long long delta2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
        res += compute(x + sum1 * delta2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
    }
    return res;
